_comment: How long a real crewmate takes per task, in seconds.
Sourced from community timing guides and wikis (see DATASET_SOURCES.md).
These are the numbers an impostor has to match, because a fake that returns
from a panel faster than a real task is the single most common tell.
seconds: [typical_min, typical_max]  what a real crewmate takes
visual:  true if other players can SEE the task happening
fakeable: false when faking it is a bad idea even though it is allowed
visual tasks: a fake cannot convincingly reproduce the on-screen activity, so
an impostor standing at one for the right length of time still looks wrong.
The bot refuses these unless explicitly told to fake anyway.
Ranges, not fixed numbers, because real players vary. A bot that always takes
exactly 8.5s on a download is as suspicious as one that takes 3s.
_visual_note: Corrected against the Among Us Wiki's Visual tasks page. The previous list
was wrong: it included Chart Course and Start Reactor, NEITHER of which is
visual, and it missed Prime Shields, Empty Garbage and Empty Chute.
Visual-ness is per MAP, and for Empty Garbage/Empty Chute it is only the
SECOND stage (Storage) that shows anything to other players. The Cafeteria
lever of Empty Garbage has no visible effect at all, so faking THAT is fine.
Airship and Fungle have no visual tasks whatsoever.

Start Reactor.note: NOT visual - corrected. Simon sequence, varies with skill

Chart Course.note: NOT visual - corrected. drag the ship along the line

Inspect Sample.note: timer keeps running if you walk away

Fuel Engines.note: per stage; four stages across the ship

Clear Asteroids.note: missiles fire outside the ship; NOT visual on Mira HQ

Prime Shields.note: the shields light up; NOT visual on Mira HQ

Swipe Card.note: hugely variable; 3s looks like a fake

Empty Garbage.note: ONLY the Storage stage is visual. The Cafeteria lever shows nothing, so faking stage 1 is safe

Empty Chute.note: same as Empty Garbage - only the Storage stage is visible
